name: Chișinău (Moldova)

colors.symbolism: the two groups of narrow stripes

description: A white field with two groups of three narrow golden stripes forming a stylised belt, bearing the coat of arms of Chișinău at the centre.
history: Chișinău is the capital and largest city of Moldova. The flag, designed by Gheorghe Vrabie and Eudochia Cojocaru-Vrabie, was approved by the city council and the National Heraldic Commission in 1998.

features.role: two groups of three narrow stripes forming a stylised golden belt
